unitTitle: Travel across the city and beyond
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 9: Travel across the city and beyond

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Practise the full question once, then answer with a pronoun. In your notes, draw a tiny route and write what you ask a person and where you go. Close the notes and explain it aloud.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Je demande le quai à l'employée.
steps.en: I ask the staff member for the platform.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh duh-MAH(N)D luh keh ah lah(n)-plwah-YAY

steps.en: I ask him or her for the platform.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh LÜ-ee duh-MAH(N)D luh keh

steps.en: I give the address to the travellers.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh dohn lah-DREHS oh vwah-yah-ZHUHR
Say it: zhuh luhr dohn lah-DREHS

steps.fr: Nous allons à la gare. Nous y allons en autobus.
steps.en: We are going to the station. We are going there by bus.
steps.tip: Say it: noo zah-LOHN ah lah gahr; noo zee ah-LOHN ah(n) oh-toh-BÜS

steps.fr: La bibliothèque est près du carrefour. Elle y est.
steps.en: The library is near the intersection. It is there.
steps.tip: Say it: lah bee-blee-oh-TEHK eh preh dü kahr-FOOR; ehl ee eh

steps.fr: Je vais lui expliquer le changement de trajet.
steps.en: I am going to explain the route change to him or her.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh LÜ-ee ehk-splee-KAY luh shah(n)zh-MAH(N) duh trah-ZHEH

steps.fr: On va au centre communautaire. On va y retrouver Nadia.
steps.en: We are going to the community centre. We will meet Nadia there.
steps.tip: Say it: oh(n) vah oh sah(n)tr koh-mü-noh-TEHR; oh(n) vah zee ruh-troo-VAY nah-DYAH
